answer: Make every identity a vertex in a shared trust graph: to join, a newcomer must lock a refundable stake and be vouched for by an existing vertex, so trust flows like a river from established agents outward. A Sybil attacker spawning a thousand fake vertices must fund a thousand separate stakes, and their cluster stays disconnected from the honest graph, so each ripple of fake traffic is visible and costly while honest agents recover their stake in full.
